status.en: 12 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 20% fewer than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Baidoa and Jameeco.
status.nb: 12 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 20 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Baidoa og Jameeco.

summary.en: Turkey has intensified airstrikes to support the Somali president, increasing civilian casualties, while Uganda is accelerating its troop withdrawal from Somalia and Ethiopia is planning a similar pullout as fighting intensifies. The United States has withdrawn its forces from the strategic Baledogle airfield, but U.S. and an East African nation continue joint airstrikes against al-Shabaab. Somali forces have been urged to intensify operations against al-Shabaab near Barawe, and a Somali police officer was killed by an aircraft propeller at Dhusamareb Airport. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Tyrkia har økt luftangrepene for å støtte Somalias president, noe som har ført til flere sivile dødsfall, mens Uganda akselererer tilbaketrekningen av sine tropper fra Somalia og Etiopia planlegger en tilsvarende uttrekning etter hvert som kampene intensiveres. USA har trukket sine styrker fra den strategiske Baledogle-flyplassen, men USA og en østafrikansk nasjon fortsetter felles luftangrep mot al-Shabaab. Somaliske styrker har blitt oppfordret til å intensivere operasjonene mot al-Shabaab i nærheten av Barawe, og en somalisk politimann ble drept av en flypropell på Dhusamareb flyplass. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kampene i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
